name: Sri Satyanarayana Swamy Temple Gudem Gutta
description: Revered hillock shrine dedicated to Lord Satyanarayana Swamy along the Godavari River, popularly known as the 'Annavaram of Telangana'.

name: Yeshwanthraopet waterfalls
description: A picturesque natural waterfall spot surrounded by lush greenery, best visited during and after the monsoon season.

name: Anthargaon Lake View Point
description: A serene lake offering tranquil water views, suitable for quick getaways or viewing sunrises and sunsets.

name: Qila Fort Jagtial
description: An 18th-century star-shaped fort built during the era of the Nawabs with historical European influence and architectural elements.

name: Kawal Tiger Reserve
description: An expansive teak forest habitat forming part of the Deccan western ghats, housing diverse wild animals and birdlife.

name: Sri Anjaneya Swamy Temple | Kondagattu
description: A prominent and historical hill temple dedicated to Lord Anjaneya (Hanuman), drawing large pilgrimages year-round.
